reactions.gut_reaction: Wait, actual prison for botting streams? I get sketchy 'playlist promo' DMs every week, so I need to hear how he got caught, and this is going straight to the band chat.
'97% couldn't tell' has big 'only 3% can pass this test' energy, but I'm a musician, so obviously I'm taking it, and I'm sending it to my drummer to prove he can't.
'Nobody listens, artists pay' is basically my royalty statement in four words; I'd stop, and I'd probably repost it so my listeners get why it matters what they stream.
HALF? Okay, that's a gut punch, but then the voice says 'one app's' and I'm like, which app, and why does the big text leave that bit out?
Yeah, they're skimming mine too, but 'your favorite artist' makes me picture some huge pop star, and I'm not losing sleep over her pay.
Every AI-music video opens like this; 'might' is doing a lot of work, my gut says 'no I don't', and I keep scrolling.
'Can shrink' sounds like a maybe, and 'paycheck'? Streams are pocket money, nobody's getting a paycheck, so it just slides past me.
I know the answer is 'people like me', but 'bots play AI songs' reads like a riddle about robots, too abstract to catch me mid-scroll.
Reads exactly like an 'earn passive income with AI music' hustle ad, so I'm gone before I find out it's actually on my side.
